_instructions: Add each group member as one object inside the people array below.
The website ignores this _instructions section, so you may keep it here.
Each person's name must be unique. The website uses it automatically to open the correct profile page.
role: their role in the group, such as Undergraduate Researcher or Faculty Advisor.
interests: optional research interests. These appear on the person's profile page, not on their People card.
photo: optional filename from assets/images/profile_pictures/, for example jane-smith.jpg. A full path also works.

honors: optional fellowships or named awards, as a list. Each one may be plain text, for example "NSF Graduate Research Fellow", or an object with short, name and url. Use short for a card-sized abbreviation such as "NSF GRFP"; the full name still shows on the profile page and in the tooltip. url is optional and links the tag on the profile page.
themes: optional list of research areas, for example ["Gravitational lensing", "Cosmology"]. The People card shows the first three and the profile page shows all of them.
status: optional. Leave it out for present members; use alumni only for former members.
email: optional public email address. It appears as a clickable email link on the person's profile page.
orcid: optional ORCID iD, written as 0000-0000-0000-0000. It enables the publication updater and View papers on ADS link for that person.
website: optional personal or professional website, such as https://example.com. A domain without https:// also works. This creates a Personal website link on their profile page.
